source.title: 地質図学の基礎演習無償版

variables.theta: horizontal angle from strike to section direction

gaps.units: angles; one declared angular unit throughout
gaps.requiredImplementation: Convention-safe plane/vertical-section intersection and signed apparent-dip calculation

gaps.units: all positions in one declared length/CRS contract
gaps.requiredImplementation: Plane fit, degeneracy rejection, strike/dip derivation and residual audit

gaps.expression: true thickness is normal distance between bounding geological surfaces
gaps.requiredImplementation: Separate true, vertical, map-apparent and section-apparent thickness types

gaps.units: CRS and elevation datum must be explicit
gaps.requiredImplementation: Bind mapped contact traces and terrain elevations to implicit geological surfaces
Observation-constrained limb/hinge alternatives with normal-thickness and event-order gates

exclusions: No claim that a unique subsurface truth can be recovered
No copying of source diagrams or prose
No production adoption of manual fold-construction methods without corroboration
validationMethod: Positive, negative, boundary, conflicting-evidence, missing-data and out-of-scope tests before adoption
reopenCondition: Reopen when implementing map-derived plane geometry or after a current authoritative structural-geology source is bound
